subject: Update comments and log message in cluster_legacy.c (#1561)
reason: The change only rewrites code comments and rewords two serverLog message strings in clusterProcessPacket (cluster_legacy.c). No control flow, data handling, protocol, or reply behaviour changes: the same branches run, the same freeClusterLink/assert calls execute, only log text and comment formatting differ. Log wording is not an oracle-observable behaviour, so no scenario can meaningfully test it.
